evidence_caveats: QL-VLM diagnostics and trained baselines are different settings. Three supervised datasets separately trained; M3CoT 4bit below FP. Six serial latent steps included in decoding denominator. v1 references an absent full appendix.

GEM-MM trainer scaffold is not a full executable implementation. Chosen labels used during common SFT. Implicit preference gain not significant, remains below 50%; judge disagreement and format/continue-training collapse included.

Search-RSI Avg is six benchmarks, not all table columns. Support staging/commit and frozen evaluation index distinguished. Extra 1.27x training compute and more inference calls explicit; inherited HaPO not replaced with invented GRPO formula.

Prism backbone total/active experts distinguished. GPT-5.5 prompt seeds and automatic evaluation are external despite internal target construction. Eq9 i2t weight notation inconsistency explicit. Judge noise, verification failures, joint-judge collapse and out-of-scope metric declines included.

Subliminal is matched hard-label LoRA SFT audit, not a new RL optimizer. More data at fixed epochs means more steps. Small-update alignment is a possibility argument, not a proof of preference monotonicity or decoded hidden representations.
